## Orange Logic Unveils Orange Builder to Create Brand Sites in Minutes

Orange Logic today unveiled Orange Builder, an AI-native builder that turns designs and ideas into working brand sites, portals and microsites in minutes.

[READ THE ANNOUNCEMENT](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260930929679/en/Orange-Logic-Unveils-Orange-Builder-to-Create-Brand-Sites-in-Minutes)

SEPTEMBER 22, 2026 · PRESS RELEASE

## LIONSGATE ADVANCES CONTEXT-AWARE VIDEO INTELLIGENCE  WITH ORANGE LOGIC AND COMCAST TECHNOLOGY SOLUTIONS

Lionsgate is connecting frame-level video insights from Comcast Technology Solutions with its own title, character, and talent context in Orange Logic. The result is natural-language discovery across more than 2,000 hours of video.

[READ THE ANNOUNCEMENT](https://www.nasdaq.com/press-release/lionsgate-advances-context-aware-video-intelligence-orange-logic-and-comcast)

![Orange Logic, Lionsgate, and Comcast Technology Solutions logo lockup](https://www.orangelogic.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Orange_Logic_Lionsgate_Comcast_Logo_Lockup_Vertical.png?width=1200&height=1200&name=Orange_Logic_Lionsgate_Comcast_Logo_Lockup_Vertical.png)

SEPTEMBER 8, 2026 · PRESS RELEASE

## ORANGE LOGIC BRINGS NVIDIA NEMOTRON TO AGENT STUDIO  ADVANCING GOVERNED AI AGENTS FOR ENTERPRISE CONTENT

Agent Studio lets enterprises build AI agents that work inside governed content workflows. With NVIDIA Nemotron open models now available, teams can put agents to work on their content without giving up control.

[READ THE ANNOUNCEMENT](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260908756020/en/Orange-Logic-Brings-NVIDIA-Nemotron-to-Agent-Studio-Advancing-Governed-AI-Agents-for-Enterprise-Content)

![Orange Logic and NVIDIA announcement graphic](https://www.orangelogic.com/hs-fs/hubfs/Linkedin-1080-1080-OL-Nvidia-V02-2.png?width=2000&height=2000&name=Linkedin-1080-1080-OL-Nvidia-V02-2.png)

## THE INVISIBLE COMPLEXITY BEHIND WORLD CUP CAMPAIGNS  RIGHTS, RISK, AND REAL-TIME GOVERNANCE

In an interview with RoastBrief, Orange Logic looks at the operational work behind global campaigns: adapting content across regions, managing rights and risk, and governing it all in real time.

[READ THE INTERVIEW](https://roastbrief.us/the-invisible-complexity-behind-world-cup-campaigns-rights-risk-and-real-time-governance/)

## DAM AS A CONTEXT ENGINE  AND THE FOUNDATION OF ENTERPRISE AI AT SCALE
